name: Cause of the Fall
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: A laboratory leak that was covered up until the dead were already in the streets
A plague that moved faster than any quarantine, and burned out only after the cities did
A ritual performed in a place no one can now find, by people who thought they were saving something
A strange rain that fell for three days and left the living unchanged
A war that ended when neither side could bury its dead
No one agrees. The survivors have six stories and each one is true to somebody
A cure that worked, and then stopped working
Something came up out of the ground, and the dead followed it

name: Region
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: A rural county of farms, feed stores, and long straight roads where the nearest town is an hour away
A small city with a hospital, a university, and a river that divides the survivors
A coast of fishing towns, salt marsh, and a road that floods at high tide
A mountain valley of logging roads and a pass that closes with the first heavy snow
Suburbs that run into each other for miles, with a school and a mall as landmarks
An industrial belt of warehouses, rail yards, and a chemical plant on the edge of town
A lake district of summer cabins and one year-round store
A border country of checkpoints, empty bases, and people who crossed the line to get here

name: Season
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: First winter: hard frost, short days, and the dead slowing in the cold
Late autumn: rain, mud, and the last chance to lay in food
A thaw that reveals what the snow kept
A wet summer of insects, rot, and long days
A dry summer of fire risk and water quarrels
The first clear week after weeks of storm
A false spring that will not last
Deep winter: the roads are closed and so is the shelter

name: Starting Shelter
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: A farmhouse with a well, a cellar, and too many windows
A school gym with one working door and a generator that needs fuel
An apartment block stairwell sealed on the ground floor
A church with a strong door and a congregation that does not agree
A warehouse office above a loading bay
A garage behind a chain-link fence and a gate that can be reinforced
A roadside motel with a courtyard wall
A boat moored in a sheltered inlet

name: Nearest Settlement
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: A fortified gas station that trades fuel and news
A council-run town with a wall, rules, and a waiting list
A market in an old supermarket, open two days a week
A dock where boats come in and people are not asked too much
A militia camp that calls itself a town
A farm co-op that will trade food for labour
A hospital annex run by a doctor with too few supplies
A rail depot where a crew controls the only bridge

name: Local Power
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: A militia captain who keeps the roads open and expects to be obeyed
A trade league that sets prices and remembers who would not join
A church that feeds anyone who attends, and asks for more than food
A family that owns the only working well and knows it
A rival scavenger crew with a truck, a leader, and a grudge
A remnant of the old government with a radio and no authority
A gang that runs the bridge and calls it a toll
A doctor's network that trades medicine for protection

name: Local Threat
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: A horde drifting along the river road, not yet pointed at anything
A raider crew that takes people as well as supplies
A cult that opens doors and lets the dead in
A horror in the woods that the animals avoid
A militia that treats every stranger as a spy
A site full of noise that draws the dead
An infected animal pack with a territory
A rival crew that knows where the shelter is

name: First Omen
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: Every dog in the valley barks at the same hour
The dead are walking in a line, away from something
A radio plays a voice that should not be broadcasting
The frost forms in a pattern around the shelter
A survivor arrives with a story and no gear
The birds leave a place all at once
A door that was locked is open
The night is too quiet, and it has a direction

name: Site Detail
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: A hand-painted sign that has outlasted the business
A smell that does not belong to the room
A sound that stops when someone listens
A barricade built by someone who knew what they were doing
A path worn through the dust that is newer than the dust
A single working light
A wall of photographs with one face scratched out
A door that opens onto a wall
A child's drawing of the place, accurate and wrong
A calendar with every day crossed out until one
A pet bowl, a leash, and no animal
A radio left on a dead frequency
A vehicle parked where no vehicle should fit
A pile of shoes by the door
A meal set for more people than are here
A name repeated on every surface

name: Site Secret
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: The place was already searched by someone careful
A survivor is hiding here and has watched the party arrive
The back room is sealed from the inside
There is a second way out that the owner never advertised
The place was used for something other than its sign says
A cache is hidden under the floor or behind a wall
The last person here left a warning
The thing the party came for has been moved
A body here is not dead
The place is a trap built by people, not the dead
A radio or phone still connects somewhere
The building is on the edge of coming down

name: Site Occupant
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: The dead, and they have been here long enough to settle
The dead, recently arrived and still moving with purpose
A survivor who does not want to be found
A survivor who wants to be rescued and cannot say so
A rival scavenger crew, one room ahead
A group that has made the place a home
An animal that has claimed the warmest corner
Someone who came to die here and did not
Someone who came to die here and did
A thing that is not a person and does not move like one
No one now, but someone left in a hurry
The place itself: a machine, a fire, or a collapse waiting

name: Site Sign
source: Original content written for Cygnus Loom.
entries: A chalk mark on the door that means safe
A chalk mark on the door that means stay out
A trail of blood that starts and stops
A note in a stranger's handwriting
A fresh grave with no marker
A window opened from the inside
A vehicle with the keys still in it
A pile of belongings sorted into keep and leave
A map with this place circled
A tally of days counted on the wall
A warning written in three languages
A doorbell that still works
